name: Sailor Moon Ars
overview:
Guardians including Sailor Renove, Sailor Urzer, Sailor Rina, Sailor Shinzo, Sailor Lenas, Sailor Neos, Sailor Dere, Sailor Arsher, and Sailor Malasher.

blends classic magical girl aesthetics with high-energy Tokusatsu action, fusing cosmic magic, heroic poses, and tactical battle mechanics.
